title: Every other pasta, not spaghetti, falls short by 1 inch.
text:
Every other pasta, not spaghetti, falls short by 1 inch.. Does not work with spaghettis..this jar is tooo short. Disappointed as it was the reason I bought this for. Sorry, I am not slanting the pasta to fit in, too inefficient use of space.
However, for other pasta shapes. Works great. Be careful thta you don’t hold or grab by the lid, does come off despite its modest suction feature.
